Which of the following numbers is a prime number?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:- **

(1)Prime numbers are numbers greater than 1.

(2) They only have two factors, 1 and the number itself.

(3) This means these numbers cannot be divided by any number other than 1 and the number itself without leaving a remainder. Numbers that have more than 2 factors are known as composite numbers. ** 

Calculation:-**

Factors of 39 = 3 × 13

Factors of 87 = 3 × 29

Factors of 79 = 1 × 79

Factors of 93 = 3 × 31

So, the prime no. = 79 

**∴ The required answer is __79__.**

questions.question: The two chords AB and CD of a circle intersect at point P, such that BP = 4 cm, PD = 5 cm, and CP = 8 cm. ﬁnd the length of chord AB.
questions.solution:
**Given:- **

The two chords AB and CD of a circle intersect at point P, such that BP = 4 cm, PD = 5 cm, and CP = 8 cm. 

**Concept used:-**

In a triangle, when two lines intersect at a point and touch one segment of the triangle, then that segment is twice the length of one of the intersecting lines. AP × BP = CP × PD

**Calculation:-**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56d500252e0a516e043b3c941f851aeb899fd24f858ff55f1766693867a68dc2.png] 

According to the theorem,

AP × BP = CP × PD

⇒ AP × 4 = 8 × 5

⇒ AP = 10

∴ Chord AB = AP + BP = 10 + 4 = 14 cm 

**∴ The required answer is __14.__**

questions.question: The income of Rahul is Rs 60000 and his expenditure is Rs 40000. If his income is increased by 20% and expenditure is increased by 15%, then what will be the percentage increase in his savings?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Income** : **Expenditure** : **Savings** = 60000 : 40000 : 20000 = 3 : 2 : 1

Use weighted average: **Income** % = (**Exp** % × **Exp part** + **Sav** % × **Sav part**) / **Total parts**

20% = (15% × 2 + x% × 1) / 3

60 = 30 + x ⇒ x = 30%

**∴ The correct answer is 30%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30660466f7eab18500534d26dcf3e6b9e8001de14f81b19f42b295903342713e.png] 

**Given:** **Initial Income** = ₹60,000, **Initial Expenditure** = ₹40,000

**Formula:** **Savings** = **Income** − **Expenditure**

⇒ **Initial Savings** = 60,000 − 40,000 = ₹20,000

⇒ **New Income** = 60,000 × (120/100) = ₹72,000

⇒ **New Expenditure** = 40,000 × (115/100) = ₹46,000

⇒ **New Savings** = 72,000 − 46,000 = ₹26,000

⇒ **Increase in Savings** = 26,000 − 20,000 = ₹6,000

⇒ **Percentage Increase** = (6,000 ÷ 20,000) × 100 = 30%

**∴ The correct answer is 30%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Income-Expenditure-Savings Relation

The fundamental equation is **Income = Expenditure + Savings**. Any percentage change in one can be found if the changes in the other two and their initial ratios are known.

Alligation Method in Income

This problem can also be solved using alligation where the **ratio of expenditure to savings** is placed against their respective **percentage increases** to find the overall **income increase**.

Successive Percentage Change

If a value changes by **a%** and then **b%**, the net change is given by **(a + b + ab/100)%**. This applies to revenue (Price × Consumption) but not directly to additive relations like Income.

The average marks obtained by 19 boys of a college is 56. If the highest marks and lowest marks obtained are removed, then the average reduces by 2. What is the average of the highest and lowest marks obtained?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**The average of 19 boys is 56.

∴ The highest and lowest marks are 56.

⇒ Sum of highest and lowest marks = 56 + 56 = 112

Since the average is decreased by 2 when the highest and lowest marks are removed.

⇒ Number of boys after removing highest and lowest marks = 19 - 2 = 17

⇒ Actual sum of highest and lowest marks = 112 + 2 × 17 = 112 + 34 = 146

⇒ Average of highest and lowest marks = 146/2 = 73

**Detailed Solution:**

Total marks obtained by 19 students = 19 × 56 = 1064

Total marks of 17 students after removing highest and lowest marks = 17 × (56 – 2) = 918

Sum of highest and lowest marks = 1064 – 918 = 146

**∴ Average of highest and lowest marks = 146 ÷ 2 = 73**

questions.question: A sum of Rs. 5000 becomes Rs. 8000 in 3 years when invested in a scheme of simple interest. If the same sum is invested in a scheme of compound interest with the same yearly interest rate (compounding of interest is yearly), what will be the amount (in Rs.) after 3 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

 A sum of Rs. 5000 becomes Rs. 8000 in 3 years when invested in a scheme of simple interest.

**Formula used:- **

(1) S.I = Amount – Principal 

(2) S.I. = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:-**

S.I = Amount – Principal = 8000 – 5000 = 3000

S.I. = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 3000 = (5000 × R × 3)/100

⇒ R = 1000/50 = 20% = 1/5

∴ Amount after 3 years (at C.I.) = 5000 × 6/5 × 6/5 × 6/5 = 8640

questions.question: A table is sold at a discount of 45%. If the marked price of the table is Rs 10800, then what is the selling price (in Rs) of the table?
questions.solution:
**Given:-**

(1) A table is sold at a discount of 45%. 

(2) The marked price of the table is Rs 10800

**Formula used:- **

S.P = M.P. × (100 - Discount)/100

Where SP = selling price, MP = marked price

**Calculation:-**

⇒ S.P = M.P. × (100 - Discount)/100

⇒ S.P. = 10800 × (100 - 45)/100 

⇒ S.P. = 10800 × 55/100 

∴ S.P. = 108 × 55 = 5940 

**∴ The required answer is __5940__**

questions.question:
Which of the following statement(s) is/are CORRECT?

I. (√11 + √2) > (√8 + √5)

II. (√10 + √3) > (√7 + √6)
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

If a no. is greater than another no. than its square is also greater than another no

**Calculation:**

Checking 1st Statement (√11 + √2) > (√8 + √5)

On squaring the given statements

⇒ (√11 + √2)² > (√8 + √5)² = (√11)² + (√2)² + 2 × √11 × √2 > (√8)² + (√5)² + 2 × √8 × √5

⇒ 11 + 2 + 2 × √11 × √2 > 8 + 5 + 2 × √8 × √5 = 13 + 2 √22 > 13 + 2 √40

Condition of 1st Statement is false.

Checking 2ⁿd Statement (√10 + √3) > (√7 + √6)

On squaring the given statements

(√10 + √3)² > (√7 + √6)² = (√10)² + (√3)² + 2 × √10 × √3 > (√7)² + (√6)² + 2 × √7 × √6

⇒ 10 + 3 + 2 × √30 > 7 + 6 + 2 × √42 = 13 + 2 √30 > 13 + 2 √42

Condition of 2ⁿd Statement is false.

**∴ The answer is Neither I nor II.**

questions.question: Some girls can do a piece of work in 18 days. In how much time (in days) two times the number of such girls will complete thrice of the work?
questions.solution:
**Detailed solution:-**

Let No. of girls be G and the total work is W.

(M₁ × D₁)/W₁ = (M₂ × D₂)/W₂

⇒ (G × 18)/W = (2G × D₂)/3W

⇒ (1 × 18)/1 = (2 × D₂)/3

∴ D₂ = 18 × 3/2 = 27 days 

**∴ The required answer is __27__**

questions.question: Two trains are moving in the same direction at the speed of 24 km/hr and 50 km/hr. The time taken by faster train to cross a man sitting in the slower train is 72 seconds. What will be the length (in metres) of the faster train?
questions.solution:
**Detailed solution:-**

Let the speed of the fast train is Sf ,and the speed of the slow train is Sₛ.

⇒ (Length of the fast train)/Time = Sf – Sₛ 

⇒ (Length of fast train)/72 = 5/18 × (50 - 24) 

⇒ Length of fast train = 5/18 × 26 × 72 

**∴ Length of fast train = 520 m**

questions.question: If the sum of the interior angles of a regular polygon is 720° then how many sides does it have?
questions.solution:
**Detailed solution:-**

Number of sides = N

Sum of interior angles = (N – 2) × 180

⇒ 720 = 180N – 360

⇒ 720 + 360 = 180N

⇒ 180N = 1080

⇒ N = 6 

**∴ The required answer is __6__.**
